|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Deflector Shield Generators (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on any Star Destroyer. This starship is immune to attrition < 3 and is power + 2, and may not be targeted by opponent's Interrupts or non-artillery Weapons. Your Force generation is + 1 here. Once per turn, may ▼ one TIE here. Star Destroyers are destiny + 1 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on a Star Destroyer. Starship is power +2, immune to attrition < 3, and may not be targeted by opponent’s Interrupts or starship weapons. Star Destroyers are destiny +1. Your Force generation here is +1. During your deploy phase, may deploy a TIE here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' “any” → “a”; “This starship” → “Starship”; added “power +2,”; “3 and is power + 2,” → “3,”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “non-artillery Weapons. Your Force generation is + 1 here. Once per turn, may ▼ one TIE here.” → “starship weapons.”; “+ 1 when drawn for weapon or battle destiny.” → “+1. Your Force generation here is +1. During your deploy phase, may deploy a TIE here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 36. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Deflector Shield Generators]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
